sampler.domain_limits: Unforced default draws only: 7..13 padded grids, 2..4 tight boxes, 3..8 foreground cells, 1..3 colours and 1..3 components. This finite audit does not cover arbitrary grids, explicit overrides, reordered lessons, fewer than three demonstrations, or undeclared rivals, and is not universal induction.
sampler.label_route: public Catalog.apply with canonical Racket reference
sampler.label_scope: Every lesson/rival claim is backed by at least one source-bound demonstration label. Unlabeled generated inputs contribute only distribution and uniqueness measurements, never correctness claims.
sampler.policy: For each band and curriculum start 0 or 1, use an independent seed per lesson and direct sample indices start..start+3. Measure all four inputs. For each declared rival, choose the first training input satisfying a linked declared witness; if no linked witness is available, label all three demos. Label the union through Catalog.apply in batches of at most 64.
